key: ELIAS: Forgive me, my Lord, for this pitiful display of violence in your presence.
en: ELIAS: Forgive me, my Lord, for this pitiful display of violence in your presence.
ja: イライアス: 我が主よ、御前にてこのような情けない暴力の様をお見せしましたこと、どうかお許しください。

key: I was not expecting you, and yet my progeny and I have become engaged in yet another senseless quarrel.
en: I was not expecting you, and yet my progeny and I have become engaged in yet another senseless quarrel.
ja: あなた様がお越しになるとは思っておりませんでしたが、それでも我が子とわたしは、またしても無意味な争いに及んでしまいました。

key: I have attained some degree of enlightenment after recent reflection, and with particular reverence to our prior excursion.
en: I have attained some degree of enlightenment after recent reflection, and with particular reverence to our prior excursion.
ja: 近頃の内省により、いくばくかの悟りを得るに至りました。特に、先の遠征を敬いつつ。

key: I have attained some degree of enlightenment after recent reflection.
en: I have attained some degree of enlightenment after recent reflection.
ja: 近頃の内省により、いくばくかの悟りを得るに至りました。

key: I have come to understand that to live one's life in the ideal of service to others is a form of mere avoidance.
en: I have come to understand that to live one's life in the ideal of service to others is a form of mere avoidance.
ja: 他者への奉仕という理想のうちに人生を生きることは、単なる逃避の一形態にすぎぬのだと、理解するに至りました。

key: To keep ourselves blind to our own responsibility, we forfeit our agency in the name of piety.
en: To keep ourselves blind to our own responsibility, we forfeit our agency in the name of piety.
ja: 自らの責任に目を閉ざし続けることで、我々はけいけんの名の下に、自らの意志を手放してしまうのです。

key: Despite your gifts, I feel as if I am only just seeing this for the first time now.
en: Despite your gifts, I feel as if I am only just seeing this for the first time now.
ja: あなた様の恵みをいただきながらも、今ようやく、初めてこれを目にしたような心地がいたします。

key: Of course, surely this is by your will as well.
en: Of course, surely this is by your will as well.
ja: もっとも、これもまた、あなた様の御意志によるものなのでしょう。

key: I will, however, refrain from prostrating myself before you this time.
en: I will, however, refrain from prostrating myself before you this time.
ja: しかし、このたびばかりは、あなた様の御前にひれ伏すことは控えさせていただきます。

key: There are mistakes I must correct, and they dwell across the banister.
en: There are mistakes I must correct, and they dwell across the banister.
ja: 正さねばならぬ過ちがあり、それは手すりの向こうに住まっております。

key: I raised my child to expect and embrace servitude, and for all her defiance, she has.
en: I raised my child to expect and embrace servitude, and for all her defiance, she has.
ja: わたしは我が子を、隷属を期待し、受け入れるように育ててまいりました。彼女はあれほど反抗しながらも、そうしてまいりました。

key: Now I must teach her to seek her own ideals.
en: Now I must teach her to seek her own ideals.
ja: 今こそ、彼女に自らの理想を求めることを教えねばなりません。

key: Please understand that I cannot in good conscience relent from this.
en: Please understand that I cannot in good conscience relent from this.
ja: どうかご理解ください、良心に照らして、これを緩めるわけにはまいりません。

key: But with your blessing, I have no doubt that we shall prevail.
en: But with your blessing, I have no doubt that we shall prevail.
ja: しかし、あなた様のご加護があれば、我々が打ち勝つことに疑いはございません。

key: For my family, your blessing is always appreciated.
en: For my family, your blessing is always appreciated.
ja: 我が家族のためにも、あなた様のご加護には、いつも感謝いたしております。

key: Faciam quodlibet quod necesse est.
en: Faciam quodlibet quod necesse est.

key: What must be done for the light, will be.
en: What must be done for the light, will be.
ja: 光のためになさねばならぬことは、必ずなされましょう。

key: No weakness can abide by the light. I shall remind it of that.
en: No weakness can abide by the light. I shall remind it of that.
ja: いかなる弱さも、光の下には留まれません。それを思い知らせてやりましょう。

key: ELIAS: If we were not meant to have agency, wherefore should we have been created in the image of one who must?
en: ELIAS: If we were not meant to have agency, wherefore should we have been created in the image of one who must?
ja: イライアス: もし我々が意志を持つべきでなかったのなら、意志を持たねばならぬ御方の姿に似せて創られたのは、一体何故でありましょうか。

key: We are not instruments.
en: We are not instruments.
ja: 我々は道具ではありません。

key: We are not born with free will to be taken in the hand and utilized.
en: We are not born with free will to be taken in the hand and utilized.
ja: 手に取られ利用されるためだけに、自由意志を授かって生まれたわけではないのです。

key: We must all accept the responsibility for shaping the future.
en: We must all accept the responsibility for shaping the future.
ja: 我々は皆、未来を形作る責任を受け入れねばなりません。

key: That is the burden given to us by our ideals.
en: That is the burden given to us by our ideals.
ja: それこそが、我らの理想が我らに課した重荷なのです。

key: ANNA: okay, what are you doing?
en: ANNA: okay, what are you doing?
ja: アンナ: ちょっと、何してるの?

key: i know you may have basically lived between that rock and a hard place for however long,
en: i know you may have basically lived between that rock and a hard place for however long,
ja: あんたがずっと、板挟みみたいな状態で生きてきたのはわかってるけど、

key: but i don't trust you.
en: but i don't trust you.
ja: あんたのことは信用してない。

key: whatever it is you're planning, just know i'll be ready for you!
en: whatever it is you're planning, just know i'll be ready for you!
ja: 何を企んでるのか知らないけど、あたしはいつでも迎え撃つ準備ができてるからね!

key: i'm getting better with this power, i think!
en: i'm getting better with this power, i think!
ja: この力、だんだん上手く使えるようになってきたと思う!

key: i realized i made a friend!
en: i realized i made a friend!
ja: 友達ができたんだって気づいたの!

key: but then, it was already with me all along in some sense, right?
en: but then, it was already with me all along in some sense, right?
ja: まあ、ある意味ではずっと一緒にいたんだけどね?

key: that pendant, it feels the same as it does!
en: that pendant, it feels the same as it does!
ja: あのペンダントも、同じような感じがする!

key: maybe that's why we're friends!
en: maybe that's why we're friends!
ja: だから友達になれたのかもね!

key: and lin, i'll tell you something?
en: and lin, i'll tell you something?
ja: それとリン、一つ言っておくけど?

key: baby arceus wants to stop you just as much as i do!
en: baby arceus wants to stop you just as much as i do!
ja: 赤ちゃんアルセウスだって、あたしと同じくらいあんたを止めたいと思ってるんだから!

key: it still hasn't recovered from what you did to it--
en: it still hasn't recovered from what you did to it--
ja: あんたがしたことから、まだ回復してないんだよ――

key: twisting it with the PULSE like that...
en: twisting it with the PULSE like that...
ja: PULSEでああやってゆがめたりして……

key: we won't let you get away with it!
en: we won't let you get away with it!
ja: 絶対にそんなこと許さない!

key: so sure, do whatever you want with that stupid hunk of space junk.
en: so sure, do whatever you want with that stupid hunk of space junk.
ja: まあ、そのくだらない宇宙ゴミで好きにすればいいけど。

key: but if you dare to get near us, be ready!
en: but if you dare to get near us, be ready!
ja: でも、あたしたちに近づこうっていうなら、覚悟しといてよね!

key: we're going to be giving you everything we've got!
en: we're going to be giving you everything we've got!
ja: 全力でぶつかっていくから!

key: LIN: okay, what are you doing.
en: LIN: okay, what are you doing.
ja: リン: ちょっと、何してんの。

key: hold on, let's think about this.
en: hold on, let's think about this.
ja: 待って、ちょっと考えよう。

key: i'm opening the way for the others to get to me...
en: i'm opening the way for the others to get to me...
ja: あたしは、みんながあたしのところに来られるように道を開いてるわけで……

key: why???
en: why???
ja: なんで???

key: is this about what i said before--
en: is this about what i said before--
ja: 前に言ったこと絡み――

key: absolute power must be absolutely answered??
en: absolute power must be absolutely answered??
ja: 「絶対的な力には絶対的な応えを」ってやつ??

key: i mean-- i was just kind of saying stuff to fill the edgy villain role.
en: i mean-- i was just kind of saying stuff to fill the edgy villain role.
ja: まあ――なんかエッジの効いた悪役っぽく振る舞うために言ってただけなんだけど。

key: no one seriously expects to be able to take a little girl seriously, right?
en: no one seriously expects to be able to take a little girl seriously, right?
ja: 小さい女の子のことを、本気で真剣に受け止めようとする人なんていないでしょ?

key: it was just a character,
en: it was just a character,
ja: ただのキャラ設定だったんだって、

key: and like i'm not saying i'm NOT corrupt with power, but, c'mon.
en: and like i'm not saying i'm NOT corrupt with power, but, c'mon.
ja: 力に溺れてないとは言わないけどさ、でも、まさかね。

key: ...no, that is the problem, isn't it?
en: ...no, that is the problem, isn't it?
ja: ……いや、それこそが問題なんじゃない?

key: even doing this gets boring all the time!
en: even doing this gets boring all the time!
ja: こんなことやってても、しょっちゅう退屈になっちゃうし!

key: i'm basically still just playing with dolls in my room with the door locked.
en: i'm basically still just playing with dolls in my room with the door locked.
ja: 結局のところ、ドアに鍵をかけた部屋の中で、まだ人形遊びしてるようなものなんだよね。

key: eventually i have to open the door and interact with people???
en: eventually i have to open the door and interact with people???
ja: いつかはドアを開けて、人と関わらなきゃいけないわけで???

key: but people are smelly and they do things like talk about politics!
en: but people are smelly and they do things like talk about politics!
ja: でも人間って臭いし、政治の話とかしてくるし!

key: ...still, i guess i can't keep myself entertained forever.
en: ...still, i guess i can't keep myself entertained forever.
ja: ……まあでも、ずっと一人で楽しんでるわけにもいかないか。

key: so, why not invite an entire army of people who probably mostly want me dead right into my doorstep!
en: so, why not invite an entire army of people who probably mostly want me dead right into my doorstep!
ja: だから、あたしを殺したがってる人たちの軍勢を丸ごと、あたしの玄関先に招待しちゃおうかな!

key: it'll be fun!
en: it'll be fun!
ja: 楽しそうじゃん!

key: i'll make sure to have enough refreshments for everyone, okay?
en: i'll make sure to have enough refreshments for everyone, okay?
ja: みんなの分の軽食もちゃんと用意しとくから、いい?

key: so bring the whole squad!
en: so bring the whole squad!
ja: だから、チーム全員連れてきてよね!

key: 100% labradorra tier raid, let's go!
en: 100% labradorra tier raid, let's go!
ja: 100パーセント、ラブラドーラ級レイド、いくよ!

key: i'm looking forward to the party!
en: i'm looking forward to the party!
ja: パーティー、楽しみにしてる!

key: definitely!!!
en: definitely!!!
ja: 絶対にね!!!

key: The crystal gleams ineffectually in the light.
en: The crystal gleams ineffectually in the light.
ja: 結晶は、光の中でむなしく輝いている。

key: The crystal flickers ineffectually in the unstable lighting.
en: The crystal flickers ineffectually in the unstable lighting.
ja: 結晶は、不安定な光の中でむなしく明滅している。

key: SERRA: The... last mirror is broken.
en: SERRA: The... last mirror is broken.
ja: セラ: その……最後の鏡が割れてるじゃない。

key: Of course it is.
en: Of course it is.
ja: まあ、そうよね。

key: It would've been too easy otherwise, right?
en: It would've been too easy otherwise, right?
ja: じゃなきゃ、簡単すぎたもんね?

key: But there's no way we're going to be able to activate four crystals with only three mirrors.
en: But there's no way we're going to be able to activate four crystals with only three mirrors.
ja: でも、鏡が三枚しかないのに、結晶四つを起動できるわけないでしょ。

key: What even was the point of all of this?
en: What even was the point of all of this?
ja: これ全部、一体何の意味があったのよ?

key: Every time we try, it's just a let down in the end.
en: Every time we try, it's just a let down in the end.
ja: 試すたびに、結局がっかりするだけ。

key: We shouldn't have wasted our time.
en: We shouldn't have wasted our time.
ja: 時間を無駄にすべきじゃなかったわ。

key: Might as well go home.
en: Might as well go home.
ja: もう帰った方がましね。

key: Stupid thing...
en: Stupid thing...
ja: バカみたいなもの……

key: Broken mirrors don't do anything for anyone.
en: Broken mirrors don't do anything for anyone.
ja: 割れた鏡なんて、誰の役にも立たないし。

key: Why bother?
en: Why bother?
ja: なんでこんなことする必要があるの?

key: SERRA: Uh.
en: SERRA: Uh.
ja: セラ: あら。

key: Did that light just...
en: Did that light just...
ja: 今の光って……

key: Did it just shoot through me?
en: Did it just shoot through me?
ja: あたしを貫いていったの?

key: SERRA: ...\PN, this is going to be an odd request.
en: SERRA: ...\PN, this is going to be an odd request.
ja: セラ: ……\PN、変なお願いなんだけど。

key: But I definitely felt that just then.
en: But I definitely felt that just then.
ja: でも、今確かに感じたのよ。

key: Use me as your last mirror.
en: Use me as your last mirror.
ja: あたしを最後の鏡として使って。

key: I... think I can redirect the light in any direction you want.
en: I... think I can redirect the light in any direction you want.
ja: あたし……あなたの望む方向に、光を反射できると思うの。

key: Maybe this is still solvable.
en: Maybe this is still solvable.
ja: まだ解けるかもしれない。

key: SERRA: Use me as your last mirror.
en: SERRA: Use me as your last mirror.
ja: セラ: あたしを最後の鏡として使って。

key: I'll stand anywhere you need in here.
en: I'll stand anywhere you need in here.
ja: ここなら、どこにでも立つから。

key: Just turn the lights off and direct me.
en: Just turn the lights off and direct me.
ja: 明かりを消して、あたしに指示して。

key: SERRA: That... did it then?
en: SERRA: That... did it then?
ja: セラ: それで……できたの?

key: SERRA: Oh, yes it did!
en: SERRA: Oh, yes it did!
ja: セラ: あ、できた!

key: The door is finally open!
en: The door is finally open!
ja: やっと扉が開いたわ!

key: Perhaps I was giving up too early after all.
en: Perhaps I was giving up too early after all.
ja: やっぱり、あたし諦めるのが早すぎたのかもね。

key: It would be in-character.
en: It would be in-character.
ja: らしいと言えばらしいけど。

key: You can take it from here, right?
en: You can take it from here, right?
ja: ここから先はお願いね?

key: No doubt there's another Anomaly in there.
en: No doubt there's another Anomaly in there.
ja: 中には間違いなく、また別のアノマリーがいるはず。

key: I'll take a moment, and then I'll go see if I can get those two in the back to put down the proverbial guns.
en: I'll take a moment, and then I'll go see if I can get those two in the back to put down the proverbial guns.
ja: あたしはちょっと休んでから、奥にいる二人に、そのたとえの銃を下ろさせられないか見てくるわ。

key: Sit it out and maybe talk like reasonable people.
en: Sit it out and maybe talk like reasonable people.
ja: 座って、まともに話し合ってくれたらいいんだけど。

key: With any luck, by the time you're one Legendary richer, maybe at least two of us will be on terms that could reasonably constitute a happy family.
en: With any luck, by the time you're one Legendary richer, maybe at least two of us will be on terms that could reasonably constitute a happy family.
ja: 運が良ければ、あなたが伝説を一体増やす頃には、少なくともあたしたちのうち二人くらいは、まあまあ幸せな家族と呼べる関係になってるかもね。

key: I wouldn't hold my breath,
en: I wouldn't hold my breath,
ja: 期待はしないけど、

key: But then, maybe I should.
en: But then, maybe I should.
ja: でも、期待してみるべきなのかもね。

key: SERRA: You can take it from here, right?
en: SERRA: You can take it from here, right?
ja: セラ: ここから先はお願いね?

key: No doubt there's another Anomaly through that door.
en: No doubt there's another Anomaly through that door.
ja: あのドアの向こうには、間違いなく別のアノマリーがいるはず。

key: You'll probably just need to activate the blue crystal again.
en: You'll probably just need to activate the blue crystal again.
ja: 青い結晶をもう一度起動するだけでいいと思う。

key: Don't worry, that door should stay open now.
en: Don't worry, that door should stay open now.
ja: 心配しないで、あのドアはもう開いたままのはずだから。

key: I hope.
en: I hope.
ja: ……たぶん。

key: The Key reacted to the Crystal!
en: The Key reacted to the Crystal!
ja: 鍵が　クリスタルに　反応した!

key: LUNA: Ah, good day, \PN.
en: LUNA: Ah, good day, \PN.
ja: ルナ: あら、ごきげんよう、\PN。

key: Are you doing well?
en: Are you doing well?
ja: お元気ですか?

key: I trust you're enjoying the scenery, to whatever capacity it may be enjoyed under the circumstances.
en: I trust you're enjoying the scenery, to whatever capacity it may be enjoyed under the circumstances.
ja: この状況で楽しめる範囲でではありますが、景色を楽しんでいただけているものと信じておりますわ。

key: This man has once again chosen to engage in his favorite past-time of appearing from out of nowhere and incessantly expressing all of his dearest opinions on how I should be living my life.
en: This man has once again chosen to engage in his favorite past-time of appearing from out of nowhere and incessantly expressing all of his dearest opinions on how I should be living my life.
ja: この方はまたしても、どこからともなく現れて、わたくしがどう生きるべきかについての大切なご意見を延々と述べるという、お気に入りの趣味に興じることをお選びになりましたの。

key: I suppose he is very much like a parent in that regard, but I do not accept him.
en: I suppose he is very much like a parent in that regard, but I do not accept him.
ja: その点では、まさに親のようなものなのでしょうけれど、わたくしは受け入れておりません。

key: As such, I do hope you will forgive the mild disturbance.
en: As such, I do hope you will forgive the mild disturbance.
ja: というわけで、ささやかなお邪魔をどうかお許しくださいませ。

key: It does me no pleasure to cause any form of inconvenience to anyone at all,
en: It does me no pleasure to cause any form of inconvenience to anyone at all,
ja: 誰かにご迷惑をおかけすることは、わたくしにとって何の喜びにもなりませんが、

key: Except him, I suppose.
en: Except him, I suppose.
ja: この方に対しては別、ということでしょうか。

key: I shall redouble my efforts and dispatch with him at once.
en: I shall redouble my efforts and dispatch with him at once.
ja: 一層の努力をもって、すぐさま彼を片付けてまいりますわ。

key: LUNA: If I were to relent in the face of trifling opposition such as this, I would not be the person I am today.
en: LUNA: If I were to relent in the face of trifling opposition such as this, I would not be the person I am today.
ja: ルナ: このようなつまらない抵抗の前で引き下がるようでは、今のわたくしではいられませんもの。

key: Let us turn out the lights, and put this rest.
en: Let us turn out the lights, and put this rest.
ja: 明かりを消して、これに決着をつけましょう。

key: LUNA: Let it be settled in darkness again.
en: LUNA: Let it be settled in darkness again.
ja: ルナ: 再び闇の中で、決着をつけましょう。

key: LUNA: It is the rare adversary who acts with a truly evil heart.
en: LUNA: It is the rare adversary who acts with a truly evil heart.
ja: ルナ: 真に邪悪な心をもって行動する敵など、めったにおりませんわ。

key: It is precisely for that reason that we must steel ourselves even against the noblest of intentions.
en: It is precisely for that reason that we must steel ourselves even against the noblest of intentions.
ja: だからこそ、たとえ最も気高い意図に対してであろうと、わたくしたちは心を鋼のようにしておかねばならないのです。

key: The road to hell shall not pave itself.
en: The road to hell shall not pave itself.
ja: 地獄への道は、ひとりでには敷かれませんもの。

key: SERRA: Oh, thank god. The cavalry is here.
en: SERRA: Oh, thank god. The cavalry is here.
ja: セラ: ああ、助かった。援軍が来てくれた。

key: Help.
en: Help.
ja: 助けて。

key: SERRA: Luna and Elias are in the back, doing god knows what.
en: SERRA: Luna and Elias are in the back, doing god knows what.
ja: セラ: ルナとイライアスが奥で、一体何をしてるんだか。

key: This has been going on basically since we got here and neither of them will back down.
en: This has been going on basically since we got here and neither of them will back down.
ja: ここに来てからずっとこの調子で、どっちも一歩も譲らないの。

key: I'm pretty sure I'm going to be seeing in strobe vision for the next ten years.
en: I'm pretty sure I'm going to be seeing in strobe vision for the next ten years.
ja: これから十年くらい、目の前がずっとストロボみたいにチカチカして見えそうな気がするわ。

key: But I assume it was you who got them to stop playing like a strobe light back there.
en: But I assume it was you who got them to stop playing like a strobe light back there.
ja: でも、あそこのストロボ光線ごっこを止めさせてくれたのは、あなたなんでしょうね。

key: Thanks for that.
en: Thanks for that.
ja: ありがとう。

key: Please help.
en: Please help.
ja: 助けて、お願い。

key: SERRA: There's some kind of puzzle mechanism here, but there's no point in even bothering to try it with the two in the back.
en: SERRA: There's some kind of puzzle mechanism here, but there's no point in even bothering to try it with the two in the back.
ja: セラ: ここに何かパズルの仕掛けがあるんだけど、奥のあの二人がいる間は、試すだけ無駄よ。

key: And they won't listen to me at all.
en: And they won't listen to me at all.
ja: あたしの言うことなんて、全然聞いてくれないし。

key: SERRA: I see you got them to spare our respective eyeballs.
en: SERRA: I see you got them to spare our respective eyeballs.
ja: セラ: あたしたちの目を守ってくれたみたいね。

key: Pretty sure standing in a dark temple while my colleagues create photosensitivity risk factors isn't something that's covered on my vision plan.
en: Pretty sure standing in a dark temple while my colleagues create photosensitivity risk factors isn't something that's covered on my vision plan.
ja: 同僚たちが光過敏のリスク要因を作り出してる暗い神殿の中に立つなんて、あたしの視力保険の対象には絶対入ってないと思うわ。

key: SERRA: Well, it was my fault anyway.
en: SERRA: Well, it was my fault anyway.
ja: セラ: まあ、そもそもあたしのせいなんだけどね。

key: Had the bright idea that maybe I ought to try this whole "parenting" thing a little more,
en: Had the bright idea that maybe I ought to try this whole "parenting" thing a little more,
ja: 「子育て」ってやつを、もう少し頑張ってみようかなんて名案を思いついちゃって、

key: And there's at least one person in my life who's still actively receptive to it.
en: And there's at least one person in my life who's still actively receptive to it.
ja: あたしの人生には、まだそれをちゃんと受け入れてくれる人が、少なくとも一人はいるし。

key: But the whole father business has hung over me since you, the priest, and the teleporting PokéMart all walked into my life like the start of a bad joke.
en: But the whole father business has hung over me since you, the priest, and the teleporting PokéMart all walked into my life like the start of a bad joke.
ja: でも、あなたとあの神父さんと、テレポートするポケモンセンターが、まるでできの悪いジョークの始まりみたいにあたしの人生に入ってきてから、この「父親」ってやつがずっとあたしにのしかかってるの。

key: So I invited them both out here.
en: So I invited them both out here.
ja: だから、二人ともここに招待したのよ。

key: ...Luna and Elias, that is. Not the PokéMart.
en: ...Luna and Elias, that is. Not the PokéMart.
ja: ……ルナとイライアスをね。ポケモンセンターじゃなくて。

key: Thought we could have some "bonding time".
en: Thought we could have some "bonding time".
ja: 「きずなを深める時間」ってやつが持てるかと思って。

key: Lesson learned, don't worry.
en: Lesson learned, don't worry.
ja: もう懲りたから、心配しないで。

key: I'd say I only want to atone for my sins now, but I don't really want to be dunked head-first in holy water by that man in particular.
en: I'd say I only want to atone for my sins now, but I don't really want to be dunked head-first in holy water by that man in particular.
ja: 今はもう罪を償いたいだけ、って言いたいところだけど、あの人に頭から聖水に突っ込まれるのだけは勘弁してほしいわ。

key: Wouldn't be good for my hair color either.
en: Wouldn't be good for my hair color either.
ja: 髪の色にもよくなさそうだし。

key: It may be cruelty free, but somehow I doubt this dye was tested to withstand the omniscient gaze of the Lord.
en: It may be cruelty free, but somehow I doubt this dye was tested to withstand the omniscient gaze of the Lord.
ja: 動物実験はしてないんだろうけど、この染料が全知全能の主の眼差しに耐えられるかどうかまでは、テストされてない気がするのよね。

key: So!
en: So!
ja: というわけで!

key: What do you say we solve whatever this mess is so we can all go on with pretending our lives aren't a complete disaster?!
en: What do you say we solve whatever this mess is so we can all go on with pretending our lives aren't a complete disaster?!
ja: このぐちゃぐちゃを何とか解決して、みんなでまた「人生はめちゃくちゃじゃない」ふりを続けようじゃない?!

key: Shall we?
en: Shall we?
ja: 始めましょうか?

key: SERRA: It had to be mirrors.
en: SERRA: It had to be mirrors.
ja: セラ: やっぱり鏡だったのね。

key: So there's that prism at the center.
en: So there's that prism at the center.
ja: で、中心にあのプリズムがある。

key: Looks like it can be activated only when it's dark enough here.
en: Looks like it can be activated only when it's dark enough here.
ja: ここが十分暗い時にしか、起動できないみたい。

key: And the end points...
en: And the end points...
ja: で、終点は……

key: It has to be those crystals, right?
en: It has to be those crystals, right?
ja: あの結晶たちのはずよね?

key: Luna told me there were similar ones in her gym.
en: Luna told me there were similar ones in her gym.
ja: ルナが、彼女のジムにも似たようなものがあるって言ってたわ。

key: Well... her valley.
en: Well... her valley.
ja: まあ……彼女の谷、だけど。

key: Don't know why she didn't just have the contractors make a structure like the rest of us...
en: Don't know why she didn't just have the contractors make a structure like the rest of us...
ja: なんで彼女だけ、あたしたちみたいに業者に建物を作らせなかったのか、わからないけど……

key: Could've even left out the lights if that's really what she's into.
en: Could've even left out the lights if that's really what she's into.
ja: 本当にそういうのが好きなら、明かりくらい省けたでしょうに。

key: Well, whatever.
en: Well, whatever.
ja: まあ、いいけど。

key: For starters, why don't we try activating the crystals one at a time?
en: For starters, why don't we try activating the crystals one at a time?
ja: とりあえず、結晶を一つずつ起動してみましょうか。

key: With just that mirror, we should be able to get two right now.
en: With just that mirror, we should be able to get two right now.
ja: あの鏡だけでも、今なら二つはいけるはずよ。

key: SERRA: That second mirror panel appeared when you activated that orb of light.
en: SERRA: That second mirror panel appeared when you activated that orb of light.
ja: セラ: あの光の球を起動したら、二枚目の鏡のパネルが現れたわ。

key: Looks like there's gonna be more to this...
en: Looks like there's gonna be more to this...
ja: まだ続きがありそうね……

key: With that second mirror, the lower left crystal should now be usable.
en: With that second mirror, the lower left crystal should now be usable.
ja: その二枚目の鏡があれば、左下の結晶が使えるようになるはず。

key: ...But since each time you fire the lights, they seem to reset.
en: ...But since each time you fire the lights, they seem to reset.
ja: ……でも、光を放つたびに、リセットされちゃうみたい。

key: So, you might need to find a way to activate more than one crystal at a time.
en: So, you might need to find a way to activate more than one crystal at a time.
ja: だから、一度に複数の結晶を起動する方法を見つける必要があるかもね。

key: That purple crystal might be the key for that.
en: That purple crystal might be the key for that.
ja: あの紫の結晶が、その鍵になるかもしれない。

key: It doesn't reset like the others, and it can be activated when the light is in motion.
en: It doesn't reset like the others, and it can be activated when the light is in motion.
ja: 他のとは違ってリセットされないし、光が動いている間に起動できるみたい。

key: It also seems to interact with the outline shapes left behind around the mirrors?
en: It also seems to interact with the outline shapes left behind around the mirrors?
ja: それに、鏡の周りに残る輪郭の形とも、何か関係があるみたい?

key: If we put all these pieces together as best we can, I think we can use it to bounce the light off of the same mirror twice.
en: If we put all these pieces together as best we can, I think we can use it to bounce the light off of the same mirror twice.
ja: これを全部うまく組み合わせれば、同じ鏡で光を二回反射させられると思う。

key: That bottom right crystal is also reachable.
en: That bottom right crystal is also reachable.
ja: 右下の結晶にも届くはずよ。

key: It might behoove us to see what effect that has.
en: It might behoove us to see what effect that has.
ja: どんな効果があるか、確かめてみた方がいいかもね。

key: SERRA: Another one on the table, huh?
en: SERRA: Another one on the table, huh?
ja: セラ: これでもう一枚、鏡が増えたのね?

key: Makes it easier, I suppose.
en: Makes it easier, I suppose.
ja: まあ、これでやりやすくなるでしょ。

key: I noticed that door above lights up whenever you activate each crystal.
en: I noticed that door above lights up whenever you activate each crystal.
ja: 結晶を一つ起動するたびに、上のドアが光るのに気づいたわ。

key: I suspect by the end we'll have to light up all four at once.
en: I suspect by the end we'll have to light up all four at once.
ja: 最後には、四つ全部を同時に光らせる必要があると思う。

key: Maybe those strange lights left behind by the mirrors are the key...
en: Maybe those strange lights left behind by the mirrors are the key...
ja: 鏡が残していく、あの奇妙な光の跡が鍵なのかもね……

key: SERRA: Looks like it went well.
en: SERRA: Looks like it went well.
ja: セラ: うまくいったみたいね。

key: We're ready to go as well.
en: We're ready to go as well.
ja: こっちの準備もできたわ。

key: And we'll be behaving, correct?
en: And we'll be behaving, correct?
ja: で、あたしたちはちゃんとお行儀よくするのよね?

key: LUNA: One could argue that 'behaving' encompasses an infinite number of actions one might undertake...
en: LUNA: One could argue that 'behaving' encompasses an infinite number of actions one might undertake...
ja: ルナ: 「お行儀よくする」というのは、無限とも言える行動の可能性を内包していると、議論することもできますが……

key: But your meaning is understood and kindly respected,
en: But your meaning is understood and kindly respected,
ja: けれど、あなたの意図は理解しておりますし、快く尊重いたしますわ。

key: So long as our choices are understood and respected in turn.
en: So long as our choices are understood and respected in turn.
ja: わたくしたちの選択もまた、同じように理解し尊重していただける限りは。

key: ELIAS: I suppose this is the part where we each go around and restate what we've learned from the ordeal?
en: ELIAS: I suppose this is the part where we each go around and restate what we've learned from the ordeal?
ja: イライアス: ここは、今回の試練から我々それぞれが学んだことを、順に語り直す場面なのでしょうか?

key: Very well.
en: Very well.
ja: 承知しました

key: I understand that, whatever revelations I may have, it is far from my place to play missionary.
en: I understand that, whatever revelations I may have, it is far from my place to play missionary.
ja: わたしにいかなる悟りがあろうとも、宣教師のような真似をするのは、わたしの分をわきまえぬ行いだと理解しております。

key: To impose personal beliefs onto others, even for their perceived benefit, is indeed a lack of respect.
en: To impose personal beliefs onto others, even for their perceived benefit, is indeed a lack of respect.
ja: たとえ相手のためになると思ってのことであれ、個人の信条を他者に押し付けるのは、まさしく敬意の欠如というものです。

key: I must trust that my daughter knows what she needs to do better than I do,
en: I must trust that my daughter knows what she needs to do better than I do,
ja: 我が娘の方が、自らのなすべきことを、わたしよりよくわかっているのだと、信じねばなりません。

key: Even if her thinking so was a product of my mistakes.
en: Even if her thinking so was a product of my mistakes.
ja: たとえ、そう考えるに至ったこと自体が、わたしの過ちの産物であったとしても。

key: LUNA: I understand rather well what you said about escaping responsibility via deference,
en: LUNA: I understand rather well what you said about escaping responsibility via deference,
ja: ルナ: 服従によって責任から逃れる、というあなた様のお言葉は、よく理解しております。

key: But you are overreaching if you assume you are responsible entirely for my feelings.
en: But you are overreaching if you assume you are responsible entirely for my feelings.
ja: ですが、わたくしの感情のすべてが、あなた様の責任であると考えるのは、思い上がりというものですわ。

key: Is it not possible that some of us simply and genuinely want to support others?
en: Is it not possible that some of us simply and genuinely want to support others?
ja: わたくしたちの中には、ただ純粋に、心から他者を支えたいと願う者もいるのではありませんか?

key: ELIAS: In somnitas veritas.
en: ELIAS: In somnitas veritas.
ja: イライアス: In somnitas veritas.

key: I would be a poor example of the Lord if I were to deny it.
en: I would be a poor example of the Lord if I were to deny it.
ja: それを否定するようでは、主の見本として、あまりに至らぬ者になってしまいましょう。

key: SERRA: Great...
en: SERRA: Great...
ja: セラ: よかった……

key: And uh, where do we stand as far as the whole parent thing?
en: And uh, where do we stand as far as the whole parent thing?
ja: で、その、「親」ってことについては、あたしたちどうなのかしら?

key: Can we stop pretending that doesn't exist?
en: Can we stop pretending that doesn't exist?
ja: もう、なかったことにするのはやめない?

key: LUNA: ...
en: LUNA: ...
ja: ルナ: ……

key: I acknowledge you as my father,
en: I acknowledge you as my father,
ja: あなたを、わたくしの父として認めます。

key: But you are not family.
en: But you are not family.
ja: けれど、家族ではありません。

key: Do you understand?
en: Do you understand?
ja: おわかりですか?

key: ELIAS: ...Plainly.
en: ELIAS: ...Plainly.
ja: イライアス: ……はっきりと。

key: LUNA: Good.
en: LUNA: Good.
ja: ルナ: 結構ですわ。

key: LUNA: Perhaps someday that can change.
en: LUNA: Perhaps someday that can change.
ja: ルナ: いつか、それが変わることもあるかもしれません。

key: ELIAS: I pray it will be so.
en: ELIAS: I pray it will be so.
ja: イライアス: そう祈っております。

key: Uncommon is the wound that time does not heal.
en: Uncommon is the wound that time does not heal.
ja: 時が癒やさぬ傷は、そう多くはございません。

key: And yet, time is insufficient.
en: And yet, time is insufficient.
ja: それでも、時だけでは足りません。

key: Responsibility is called for.
en: Responsibility is called for.
ja: 責任が求められるのです。

key: SERRA: Well, I'd say all in all it went rather well!
en: SERRA: Well, I'd say all in all it went rather well!
ja: セラ: まあ、全体としては、かなりうまくいったんじゃない!

key: The Anomaly was dealt with, those two are speaking, and nobody is dead!
en: The Anomaly was dealt with, those two are speaking, and nobody is dead!
ja: アノマリーは片付いたし、あの二人はちゃんと話してるし、誰も死んでない!

key: And I've realized I have magic mirror powers or something.
en: And I've realized I have magic mirror powers or something.
ja: それに、あたしに魔法の鏡の力みたいなのがあるってこともわかったし。

key: Probably not; I assume it's just this world.
en: Probably not; I assume it's just this world.
ja: まあ、たぶん違うでしょうけど。この世界だけの話だと思うわ。

key: But then, until somebody proves otherwise, maybe it doesn't hurt to believe.
en: But then, until somebody proves otherwise, maybe it doesn't hurt to believe.
ja: でも、誰かがそうじゃないって証明するまでは、信じてみてもいいんじゃない。

key: In fact, it feels kind of nice.
en: In fact, it feels kind of nice.
ja: というか、なんかいい気分だし。

key: ANNA: i guess they really always do return to the scene of the crime!
en: ANNA: i guess they really always do return to the scene of the crime!
ja: アンナ: やっぱり、みんな犯行現場に戻ってくるものなんだね!

key: i thought you might come back here eventually.
en: i thought you might come back here eventually.
ja: いつかここに戻ってくるだろうって思ってた。

key: i certainly can't pretend to understand what this place means to you,
en: i certainly can't pretend to understand what this place means to you,
ja: この場所があんたにとって何を意味するのか、わかったふりなんてできないけど、

key: but you faked your own death here, didn't you?
en: but you faked your own death here, didn't you?
ja: ここで、自分の死を偽装したんでしょ?

key: in this very spot.
en: in this very spot.
ja: まさにこの場所で。

key: i should've known it wouldn't be that easy.
en: i should've known it wouldn't be that easy.
ja: そんなに簡単なわけないって、わかってるべきだったな。

key: i spent every moment back then just trying to stop you-- to save our world.
en: i spent every moment back then just trying to stop you-- to save our world.
ja: あの頃はずっと、あんたを止めることだけに――この世界を救うことだけに、時間を費やしてた。

key: and i did!
en: and i did!
ja: で、実際にやったし!

key: kinda.
en: kinda.
ja: まあ、一応。

key: but you know, it's funny...
en: but you know, it's funny...
ja: でもさ、変な話だけど……

key: i tried so hard to stop you, i can hardly remember doing anything else.
en: i tried so hard to stop you, i can hardly remember doing anything else.
ja: あんたを止めることに必死すぎて、他に何をしてたか、ほとんど思い出せないんだよね。

key: even now, i wonder what i'm doing?
en: even now, i wonder what i'm doing?
ja: 今でさえ、自分が何をしてるのか、時々わからなくなる。

key: every time i blink, you're somewhere else.
en: every time i blink, you're somewhere else.
ja: まばたきするたびに、あんたはどこか別の場所にいる。

key: time is always leaving me behind.
en: time is always leaving me behind.
ja: 時間はいつも、あたしを置いていく。

key: is that your doing too?
en: is that your doing too?
ja: それも、あんたの仕業なの?

key: then with the precious moments we still have, i can't let you get away with it!
en: then with the precious moments we still have, i can't let you get away with it!
ja: だったら、残された貴重な時間で、あんたを逃がすわけにはいかない!

key: i'm giving necrozma all of my energy!
en: i'm giving necrozma all of my energy!
ja: ネクロズマに、あたしの全エネルギーを注ぐ!

key: it'll definitely stop you, no matter what!
en: it'll definitely stop you, no matter what!
ja: 何が何でも、絶対にあんたを止めてやる!

key: LIN: you found the meteor, you found the meteor~
en: LIN: you found the meteor, you found the meteor~
ja: リン: メテオを見つけたね、メテオを見つけたね~

key: that hunk o' space junk was my back porch for god knows how long!
en: that hunk o' space junk was my back porch for god knows how long!
ja: あの宇宙ゴミの塊、もうどれだけの間、あたしの裏庭代わりだったことか!

key: well, i guess i know how long,
en: well, i guess i know how long,
ja: まあ、どれくらいかはわかってるんだけど、

key: which is accurate either way!
en: which is accurate either way!
ja: どっちにしても正確ではあるし!

key: in fact, would you believe that this is the very same spot that we played at before?
en: in fact, would you believe that this is the very same spot that we played at before?
ja: てか、ここが前に一緒に遊んだのと全く同じ場所だって、信じられる?

key: meteor hasn't moved an inch, cross my heart and hope fern dies!
en: meteor hasn't moved an inch, cross my heart and hope fern dies!
ja: メテオは一ミリも動いてないよ、誓ってもいい、ファーンが死にますようにってくらい!

key: it looks a little different now, but i'm happy with what i've done with the place!
en: it looks a little different now, but i'm happy with what i've done with the place!
ja: 今は少し様子が違って見えるけど、この場所をこうしたこと、自分では気に入ってるんだ!

key: unlimited power isn't so bad, see?
en: unlimited power isn't so bad, see?
ja: 無限の力も、悪くないでしょ?

key: we can make neat things!
en: we can make neat things!
ja: 素敵なものが作れるし!

key: i even based it off its real world equivalent!
en: i even based it off its real world equivalent!
ja: 現実世界の対応する場所をモデルにまでしたんだよ!

key: not that that place exists anymore.
en: not that that place exists anymore.
ja: もっとも、その場所はもう存在しないけどね。

key: oops.
en: oops.
ja: おっと。

key: anyway, my real body is obviously long gone from here, but that's fine~
en: anyway, my real body is obviously long gone from here, but that's fine~
ja: まあとにかく、あたしの本当の体はとっくにここからいなくなってるけど、それでいいの~

key: so, let's talk shop.
en: so, let's talk shop.
ja: で、本題に入ろっか。

key: i was thinking, this is a prism Pokémon, right?
en: i was thinking, this is a prism Pokémon, right?
ja: 考えてたんだけど、こいつはプリズムポケモンでしょ?

key: so we gotta have some kind of light shenanigans.
en: so we gotta have some kind of light shenanigans.
ja: だから、光を使った何かしらの仕掛けが必要だよね。

key: what if-- and hear me out--
en: what if-- and hear me out--
ja: もし――ちゃんと聞いてよ――

key: RAINBOWS.
en: RAINBOWS.
ja: にじ。

key: LIN: what do you think, awesome, or awesome?
en: LIN: what do you think, awesome, or awesome?
ja: リン: どう思う、最高、それとも最高?

key: LIN: awesome.
en: LIN: awesome.
ja: リン: 最高。

key: so i thought it might be a fun fight.
en: so i thought it might be a fun fight.
ja: だから、楽しいバトルになるかもって思ったんだ。

key: ...but it's also kinda effort.
en: ...but it's also kinda effort.
ja: ……でも、なんかちょっと面倒でもあるんだよね。

key: i dunno, am i feeling up to a rainbow fight, or do we just stick with boring crystal cavern?
en: i dunno, am i feeling up to a rainbow fight, or do we just stick with boring crystal cavern?
ja: どうしよっかな、にじバトルする気分か、それとも退屈な結晶の洞窟のままでいくか?

key: LIN: heck yeah, rainbows!!!
en: LIN: heck yeah, rainbows!!!
ja: リン: よっしゃ、にじだ!!!

key: necrozma said gay rights
en: necrozma said gay rights
ja: ネクロズマが「ゲイの権利」って言ってた

key: well, i said gay rights, but necrozma has to live with that.
en: well, i said gay rights, but necrozma has to live with that.
ja: まあ、実際に言ったのはあたしだけど、ネクロズマにはそれを背負ってもらわなきゃ。

key: that makes me better than some governments!
en: that makes me better than some governments!
ja: これだけであたし、どこかの政府よりマシってことになるよね!

key: anyway, rainbow rave party fight, go!!!
en: anyway, rainbow rave party fight, go!!!
ja: とにかく、にじレイブパーティーバトル、いくよ!!!

key: LIN: yeah okay, i don't feel like it.
en: LIN: yeah okay, i don't feel like it.
ja: リン: うーん、やっぱその気分じゃないや。

key: we've gotten this far, let's just kick its butt.
en: we've gotten this far, let's just kick its butt.
ja: ここまで来たんだから、さっさとぶちのめそっか。

key: NECROZMA: Krohh--
en: NECROZMA: Krohh--
ja: ネクロズマ: クロォ――

key: Zaaam...
en: Zaaam...
ja: ザァム……
